description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation" represents the proportion of different data sources used in the training and evaluation of large language models. There are five slices in the chart, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 26.0%, is for "ENTITYQUEST," followed by "HOTPOTQA" at 24.2%, "TRIVIAQA" at 22.7%, "POPQA" at 21.6%, and the smallest slice, "WEBQUESTIO," at 3.6%. Each slice is labeled with the name of the data source and its corresponding percentage. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
